facts.fact: El Moudjahid says Algeria's digitalisation under the 'Algérie Numérique 2030' strategic vision proceeds under the supervision of the High Commission for Digitalisation.

El Moudjahid reports 2026 achievements under the vision, including the national digital services centre at Mohammadia with Tier III data centres and ministries joining the Dzair Digital Services portal, with no strategy target cited.
